name: R. Travis Moore
occupation: Carbon County commissioner (re-elected November 2026). The Carbon County Comet described him as chairman at the February 4, 2025, meeting.
prior_offices: Carbon County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: R. Travis Moore, also listed as Travis Moore, is a Carbon County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official commissioners page lists him as a member. The Rawlins Times reported that he received 3,031 votes in the general election, and the Carbon County Comet described him as chairman at the February 4, 2025, meeting.
